children: Belgium's Groupe Rossel, which publishes newspapers such as Le Soir and La Voix du Nord, is in talks over a possible takeover of French rival Groupe Sud Ouest, the French company said on Thursday.

Groupe Sud Ouest, whose papers include the eponymous title as well as other regional papers such as Charente Libre, said combining with Rossel would create a new entity with combined sales of more than 400 million euros ($464.8 million).
